The agent applied min(500, amount) to a charge reported days after it posted. Doc _031 lists only three tiers: $50, $500 and unlimited. The tool description says to 'Use -1 for unlimited'. Gold uses 50 or 500 even for charges below $50 (084's $47.50 charge was filed at 50 and matched).

diagnoses.change: Liability is a tier and never the amount: 50 by default (a charge since the last statement is still in time), 500 only when the customer is reporting a charge from an older statement late, -1 after 60 days. D2 then accepts only 50, 500 or -1.

(2) When wants_cc_close is set and cc_close_blocked is non-empty: 'Closing <card ids> is blocked (open dispute or pending replacement, logistics_003 Step 1): explain what must be resolved and stop. Take no further closure step on that card (balance payment, reason log, retention) and unlock no tool for one.' (task 046: the graded unlock happens before any check can see it).

risks: Liability: passing debit-dispute tasks (train and test) that gold files at 500 for late reports could now get 50 if the agent misjudges lateness. The prompt keeps 500 for a charge the customer reports late from an older statement, which matches the late-report cases in 084/086. D2 still allows 500, so it never blocks a correct tier.
check H could block a legitimate second account of the same class. A customer opening two identical accounts in one call is rare, and _once lets the third attempt through.

check B widened: a customer with an open dispute on one card who wants to close another card and pay that other card's balance is not blocked, because the block is keyed by card id. When the mapping is unknown with several cards, no card is marked blocked and the call goes through.
check_reply wording could catch a legitimate refusal that cites a document. It fires once per conversation and only asks for the citation, so a grounded refusal is kept on the rewrite.
E5: a customer who did choose a design in words the regex misses costs one extra question. That is harmless to the DB.
The rewards-method prompt line could change how recommendation or correction tasks compute. It only applies to rewards discrepancies and is grounded in the card documents.
helper.py is unchanged: the suffix strip stays (lesson 4, task 065). Check H explains its effect instead of removing it.
